page.layout: One column of running text, with a running head at the top. No margin notes and no text below the column. Italic sect names close many lines.

main_text.head: De homine.
main_text.p: Adam & Euam non esse a Deo creatos, Ma-nichæi.
Carnem hominis a Deo non esse, Patriciani,
Partes corporis nostri inferiores Diaboli opus esse, Paterniani, Eunomiani, Ethicoprocoptæ.
Adamum moriturum fuisse, etsi non peccasset, Pelagiani, Celestiani.
Hominem creatum ad similitudinem splendoris cuiusdam cœlestis, non ad Dei imaginem, Saturniniani.
In homine imaginem Dei esse in corpore, nō in anima, Melitonij, Anthropomorphitæ.
Animam hominis ab Angelis non a Deo creatam esse, Seleuciani, Hermiani, Procliani.
Animam hominis esse corpoream, & ex carne transfundi, Luciferiani, Tertullianistæ.
Anima hominis esse mortalem, & cum corpore interire, Arabici.
Animam hominis diuinæ naturæ partem esse & eiusdem cum eo essentiæ: Gnostici, Manichæi, Priscilliani stæ.
Animam hominis & brutorum animantium esse eiusdem essentiæ & naturæ, Nazarei, Ma-nichæi.

page.notes: The running head reads SYMBOLVM in print; the capital V is a vowel, so it is written SYMBOLUM. The top line is the tail of the previous page's last line; the first letters are doubtful. "Priscilliani stæ" has a printed space, kept as printed; the f-like letters in "Patriciani", "Priscilliani" and "detestantur" are read as long s. No page number, catchword or signature is printed.
